verdict.rationale: LangSmith offers a self-hosted deployment option that lets customers run the platform in their own infrastructure, which indirectly allows control over data location, but there is no documented region-selection feature or explicit data-residency options within the hosted/cloud offering. missing for 10: explicit region/residency selection controls, documentation of supported hosting regions for the SaaS offering, and independent confirmation of self-hosted deployment satisfying residency requirements.
